title.en: Today, If You Hear His Voice

heading.en: The generation that almost made it

body.en: The writer tells a sobering story. God rescued Israel from Egypt with incredible miracles, leading them toward the Promised Land. But in the wilderness, instead of trusting God, the people grumbled and hardened their hearts — again and again, for forty years! Because of their unbelief, that entire generation never entered the rest God had prepared. The writer quotes God's own warning: 'Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.' Then the urgent call: watch out, brothers and sisters, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God. Encourage one another DAILY, so none of you is hardened by sin's deceitfulness!

verse.en: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.

title.en: A Song for Today, If You Hear His Voice

q.en: Why did the wilderness generation never enter the Promised Land's rest?
What should believers do for one another daily, according to this chapter?

en: Encourage one another, so none is hardened by sin

q.en: What warning does God give about today specifically?

en: Today, if you hear His voice, don't harden your heart

label.en: Activity sheet: Today, If You Hear His Voice

body.en:
Big idea: the danger of a hardened heart, and daily mutual encouragement as the remedy — strong scriptural support against any doctrine of automatic, unconditional perseverance. The wilderness generation were genuinely rescued people who failed to enter the promised rest through persistent unbelief (3:16-19).

Conversation starters: (1) Is a hardened heart usually one big moment or many small ones? (2) Who encourages you daily, and who can you encourage? (3) Why "today" specifically — why not wait?

Pray for soft, responsive hearts and faithful daily encouragement.
